        - heading "Worked example" [level=2]
        - paragraph: Given r = 4. Find the volume and total surface area of the hemisphere.
        - heading "Solution" [level=3]
        - text: Volume
        - paragraph:
          - text: V = ⅔πr³ = ⅔π(4)³ = 128/3 π
          - text: ≈ 134.04 cubic units
        - text: Total surface area
        - paragraph:
          - text: TSA = 3πr² = 3π(4)² = 48π
          - text: ≈ 150.80 square units
        - text: Answer
        - text: V = 128/3 π cubic units, TSA = 48π square units.
